description: A dog school trains labradors and golden retrievers to deliver newspaper. A labrador can deliver 7 newspapers at a time and requires 5 small bone treats for service. A golden retriever can deliver 10 newspapers at a time and requires 6 small bone treats per service. The school only has 1500 small bone treats available. In addition, at least 50 golden retrievers must be used and at most 60% of the dogs can be labradors. How many of each dog should be used to maximize the number of newspapers that can be delivered?

NumDogTypes.definition: Number of different dog types used in the school

NewspapersPerService.definition: Number of newspapers delivered per service by each dog type

TreatsPerService.definition: Number of small bone treats required per service by each dog type

TotalBoneTreatsAvailable.definition: Total number of small bone treats available

MinGoldenRetrievers.definition: Minimum number of golden retrievers to be used

MaxPercentageLabradors.definition: Maximum percentage of dogs that can be labradors

objective.description: "Maximize the total number of newspapers delivered by the labradors and golden retrievers"

constraints.description: Total small bone treats used by labradors and golden retrievers should not exceed 1500
Number of golden retrievers used should be at least 50
Number of labradors used should be at most 60% of the total number of dogs used
Number of labradors and golden retrievers used should be non-negative integers

DogsUsed.definition: Number of dogs of each type used for newspaper delivery
